Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production equipment sprite atlas for SHATTERDEEP, a premium modern pixel-art dark-fantasy action RPG. Create a transparent PNG sheet, 1536 by 1024 pixels, exactly SIX columns by FOUR rows of square 256x256 cells. Exactly 24 isolated weapons, one centered per cell, NO text, NO labels, NO grid lines, NO backdrop, NO floor, no drop shadows. Entire silhouettes including magical glows must stay inside each cell with generous transparent padding. Fine crisp pixel-art metal, leather wrapping, wood and crystal, dark dramatic aesthetic matching detailed 3/4 top-down fantasy sprites. Consistent upper-left light. Each weapon upright, tip UP, pommel DOWN. Melee/staff grip exactly around local x128 y192, tip y22; keep overall within x28..228 y12..244. Bows upright with limbs curving to the RIGHT, straight bowstring on LEFT, wood hand grip centered local x140 y128; entire bow inside x62..213 y20..236.
Read cells strictly row by row from top left:
Row1: battered rusty short sword with narrow chipped straight blade; black serrated falchion with purple rift cracks; white crescent moon bow with silver spines and pale violet string; twisted ebony staff topped by floating violet orb; practical broad steel woodcutter axe with short brown haft; heavy double-headed crimson battle axe with barbed iron and garnet core.
Row2: dark flanged iron mace with compact spiked head; square cobalt warhammer with blue lightning cracks; slender bronze winged spear with leaf point; white bone pike with ivory ribs and skull ferrule; short triangular iron dagger with leather grip; curved green venom dagger with hooked fang blade.
Row3: frosted steel longsword with angular ice edge; simple copper-bound ash recurve bow; blue crystal longbow with jagged frozen limbs; gnarled green thorn staff crowned with glowing amber seed; massive broad gold greatsword with golden fire along the edge; rusty serrated executioner's cleaver with squared tip.
Row4: red crystal blood staff with black iron cage; luminous white-gold celestial staff with star-shaped crest; round ancient runic stone hammer wrapped in bronze; long narrow raven-black bow with feather accents; barbed thorn spear wrapped in vines; elegant curved starsteel saber with cyan constellations.
Each must have a genuinely distinct shape, material and silhouette. Work as usable individual game sprites with alpha; absolutely no characters, hands, logos, inventory UI or written captions.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production EQUIPMENT sprite atlas for SHATTERDEEP, premium detailed modern pixel art dark fantasy action RPG. Transparent PNG, square 1024x1024 pixels, FOUR columns FOUR rows, exact 256x256 cells. Exactly SIXTEEN separate equipment pieces, one centered per cell, ample transparent padding, never cross cells. NO text/labels/grid/background/person/mannequin/shadows. Crisp detailed pixel clusters, weathered leather, realistic metals and woven cloth, upper-left highlights, 3/4 view facing a little toward viewer's RIGHT consistent across all items.
Row1 four CHEST ARMOR pieces only, neck opening at local x130 y44, shoulders centered y82, waist y222. No head arms or legs, but include integrated shoulder pieces: 1 practical moss-green ranger jerkin with small asymmetric leather shoulder guards; 2 dark charcoal scale mail with broad red scarf and high angular collar; 3 frosted white steel breastplate with icy-blue engravings and large angular pauldrons; 4 black purple occult robe torso with draping sleeves, silver crescent trim, violet gems, hem at y232.
Row2 four HEADGEAR pieces, same three-quarter rightward facing: 5 open brown leather hunter cowl exposing empty face opening, no face; 6 closed horned iron barbarian helmet with short swept-back horns; 7 closed white blue crystalline full-face knight helmet; 8 closed golden raven-beak mask helmet with long black feathers behind, no face.
Row3 four paired limb equipment, isolated PAIRS side by side within their cell: 9 pair of dark steel articulated gauntlets and closed gloves; 10 pair of bark-textured green leaf bracers and brown gloves; 11 pair of white icy blue armored greaves with metal boots; 12 pair of dark red leather tall rogue boots with silver buckles. Gloves fingertips point DOWN, wrists up. Boots toe shape matches 3/4 rightward facing.
Row4: 13 ragged green ranger shoulder cloak viewed from outside, no wearer, neck opening at top, fabric flaring down; 14 heavy black raven-feather cloak with red lining and bronze neck clasp, no wearer; 15 wide wooden kite shield edged in moss-covered bronze with a tree motif; 16 angular black iron tower shield with crimson dragon emblem and rivets.
All are original distinct equipment silhouettes. Strong form highlights, cyan/violet magical glow used sparingly, readable at small game size. Do not add body parts, figures, display stands, text or extra items.
